labels.name: Calm Sea Suspension
labels.def: Service halted due to low wave activity despite storm alert.

labels.name: High Wind Halt
labels.def: Operations stopped because wind speeds exceed safe vessel limits.

labels.name: Port Access Blocked
labels.def: Terminals inaccessible due to flooding or structural safety concerns.

labels.name: Crew Safety Standby
labels.def: Delays caused by inability to secure required staffing levels safely.

labels.name: Equipment Maintenance Pause
labels.def: Vessels grounded for urgent repairs triggered by storm damage.

labels.name: Regulatory Authority Order
labels.def: Mandatory stoppage issued by maritime safety officials during alerts.

confusions: Both involve weather conditions but opposite wind states cause delay.
Official bans often result from port closures, blurring cause.
Both pause operations for safety reasons involving resources or people.

hint: ferry route delays after a storm warning
